root_cause: Over 28 days the site had about 35 GA4 sessions, 230 Search Console impressions and 1 click. The SEO loop optimised revenue per opportunity but had no daily visitor metric, and 69 of about 145 LinkedIn posts carry no link by design.
prevention_rule: A daily qualified-visits 7-day average is the first-class SEO metric. Unmeasured stays UNKNOWN. Levers run in order: indexing and technical SEO, keyword-to-page match on existing pages, internal links, LinkedIn links with UTM, and new content only for a proven intent gap.

historical: Windsor.ai GA4 and Search Console readback, 28 days to 2026-11-05
